title: VideoArchitecture
description: Execution-ready video structure produced by video-structure-plan. Consumed by video-maker skills.

title.description: Short kebab-case slug for the video (e.g. founder-burnout-30s)

concept.description: 1-2 sentence summary of the inferred concept, tone, and target audience

sourceUrl.description: Original social media URL if provided as input

targetDuration.description: Total video duration in seconds; must equal sum of all segment durations (±1s)

aspectRatio.description: 9:16 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts; 16:9 for YouTube; 1:1 for feed posts

platform.description: Target distribution platform — drives duration constraints and CTA style

voiceOverlay.description: Voiceover spec. Omit entirely for silent or music-only videos.

fullScript.description: Complete spoken script for the whole video. len/14 must be ≤ targetDuration.

suggestedActor.description: Adam = default male voice; Sara = use when first segment clearly features a woman

autoCaption.description: true = burn in auto captions (style: clean). Use for speech-heavy content.

musicBackground.description: Background music spec. Omit or null for no music.

mood.description: Emotional mood of the track (e.g. upbeat, emotional, tense, chill, dramatic)

genre.description: Music genre (e.g. hip-hop, cinematic, lofi, pop, electronic, acoustic)

volume.description: 0.15 when voiceOverlay is present; 0.6 for music-only videos

suggestedTrack.description: Optional search query or known track name for the music-selection agent

segments.description: Ordered clip segments. Sum of durations must equal meta.targetDuration (±1s).

duration.description: Segment length in seconds. Minimum 2s. Typical range 3–8s.

type.description: How this footage should be sourced

query.description: Search query for stock/AI retrieval. Be specific: include subject, action, setting, lighting.

description.description: Human-readable description of what should appear in frame

preferredSource.description: Hint for which system to pull from. Default: pexels for stock footage.

textOverlay.description: On-screen text for this segment. Omit field entirely if no text needed.

text.description: Display text. Max: hook ≤6 words, CTA ≤8 words, stat ≤12 words.

role.description: Narrative function of this text in the video

timing.description: When within the segment the text appears

imageOverlay.description: Static image overlaid on the clip. Omit field entirely if not needed.

description.description: What image to show or generate (e.g. app screenshot, logo, face bubble)

placement.description: Where to position the overlay on the frame

opacity.description: Opacity of the overlay. Default 1.0 (fully opaque).

voiceScript.description: Optional per-segment voice line. Used by downstream skills for timing sync. voiceOverlay.fullScript takes precedence for TTS submission.
